parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const [h, m] = $json.hora_validada.split(':').map(Number); const total = h * 60 + m + $json.config_agenda.duracao_servico; return String(Math.floor(total / 60)).padStart(2,'0') + ':' + String(total % 60).padStart(2,'0'); })() }}
